hotspots.rationale: Bounded 2026-10-06 managed-profile, schema-40 and live-control slices; independently reviewed architectural scope. Forward immutable permission selection and startup-captured observer epoch/prepared thread into domain helpers. worker_execution owns pure execution guards; execution_journal owns checkpoint confirmation; worker_activity and preacceptance_approvals own activity observer lifetime and SQL. CodexLiveControl now owns stop/steer polling, its state connection, control clients and shutdown; the worker retains productive invocation, result checkpoints and publication. Its running context preserves primary execution failure during independent cleanup failure. The snapshot guard precedes materials, staging and client acquisition. This extraction removes monitor and steer lifecycle responsibility from the productive worker. Schema-41 preparation retry reduces responsibility: provider_admission_state owns shared transaction-required admission, state_values owns neutral values, worker_failure_notice owns shared generic failure preparation, preexecution_retry_state owns tickets/control provenance and worker_execution owns retry binding/transport guards. HubState retains each transaction; migration_sql executes trusted DDL without an implicit commit. No new invocation, approval authority or queue exemption is added. The runtime-retargeting follow-up moves existing retry/profile preflight ahead of either provider branch and uses a runtime-neutral not-started refusal. worker_execution owns the guard; retry state and HubState retain validation and transaction ownership. No new invocation, lifecycle or cleanup authority is added; the source hotspot shrinks.
